name: Eaton-Wellness-Website-UI
description: A pixel-perfect, responsive web interface for Eaton Wellness implemented to enhance skills. This project exactly replicates the design shown in Website-Design.jpg using semantic HTML and custom CSS.

paragraphs: A professional, pixel-perfect, and fully responsive web interface for Eaton Wellness, crafted as a technical assessment. This project exactly replicates the design and layout shown in the reference image (Website-Design.jpg) while ensuring a seamless experience across all device sizes.
features: Pixel-Perfect Implementation: Faithful recreation of the reference design provided in Website-Design.jpg.
Fully Responsive: Optimized layouts for mobile, tablet, and desktop views using CSS media queries.
Interactive Hamburger Menu: A custom-built mobile navigation menu for enhanced user experience on small screens.
Modern Styling: Leverages glassmorphism, smooth hover effects, and a curated color palette for a premium feel.
Clean & Semantic Code: Written with best practices in mind using HTML5 and CSS3.
